cards.card_text: Paul says this was so that God's plan of election might stand, not by works but by Him who calls.
cards.verse_text: Yet before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad, in order that God’s plan of election might stand, not by works but by Him who calls, she was told, “The older will serve the younger.”
cards.snippet: …had done anything good or bad, in order that God’s plan of election might stand, not by works but by Him who calls, she was…

cards.card_text: But when it comes to election, Paul says Israel is loved.
cards.verse_text: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
cards.snippet: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.

cards.card_text: Then Peter writes, "Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure." I was SURE I turned the oven off once, friend, and that batch came out a hockey puck.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure.
cards.snippet: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure.
